monitoring_note: Neurologic toxicity is exposure/duration related; prolonged treatment requires active monitoring.
pyridoxine_role: Do not claim pyridoxine prevents linezolid neuropathy; WHO notes prophylaxis may not prevent linezolid-associated neuropathy.

cbc_monitoring.WHO: Hb at least every 2 weeks for first month, then monthly while on linezolid; more frequent CBC if clinically indicated or baseline counts are low.
